nodes.label: Definition of Word Learned
nodes.rationale: A word is considered learned when encountered in lyrics on 3+ separate sessions AND user has tapped the word card at least once to view full definition — conservative proxy for retention.

nodes.label: API Dependencies & Risk Assessment (PRD 5.5)
nodes.rationale: Musixmatch flagged HIGH risk (mitigate via Firestore cache + fallback to unsynced lyrics + evaluate Genius API backup); gpt-4o-mini flagged LOW risk because global cache means API rarely called.

nodes.label: Case 1: Loading Delay on New Song
nodes.rationale: Progressive Display + Streaming strategy: show track title immediately, display English lyrics unstyled first, stream translations in via gpt-4o-mini, cache once complete — never show a blank screen.
nodes.norm_label: case 1: loading delay on new song

nodes.label: Case 2: User Skips Song Within 5 Seconds
nodes.rationale: AbortController strategy: abort in-flight translation request on track change to avoid wasted tokens and stale cache writes.
nodes.norm_label: case 2: user skips song within 5 seconds

nodes.label: Case 3: App Opened Mid-Song
nodes.rationale: Position-Aware Load: use first poll's position_ms to jump directly to the correct lyric line instead of starting from line 0.

nodes.label: Case 4: Network Dropout
nodes.rationale: Reconnect & Re-sync: freeze highlight silently while offline, then jump to correct current line on reconnect rather than animating through missed lines.

nodes.label: Case 5: Song Not Found in Musixmatch
nodes.rationale: Graceful Degradation: show Hebrew message that lyrics are unavailable and a report-missing-song button logging to missing_tracks collection; treated as a known handled state, not an error.
nodes.norm_label: case 5: song not found in musixmatch

nodes.label: Case 6: Shuffle Mode — No Pre-fetch Possible
nodes.rationale: Optimistic Immediate Display: disable pre-fetch in shuffle mode, rely on cache-hit-first logic identical to Case 1.
nodes.norm_label: case 6: shuffle mode — no pre-fetch possible

nodes.label: Case 7: Many Consecutive Cache Misses (New Album)
nodes.rationale: Backend Queue + Soft Rate Limit: max 1 concurrent Claude translation request per user, queue additional requests, return English-only lyrics immediately, cache-warming cost shared across user base.
nodes.norm_label: case 7: many consecutive cache misses (new album)

nodes.label: Case 8: Rapid Pause/Resume
nodes.rationale: Position Delta Detection: compare position_ms between consecutive polls instead of relying on is_playing flag, which is unreliable for short pauses.

nodes.label: Case 9: Song on Repeat (Loop)
nodes.rationale: Loop Detection: if position_ms drops below 3000ms while previous position was near duration_ms and track ID unchanged, treat as loop — reset to line 0 without re-fetching lyrics/translations.

nodes.label: UX & Design Principles (PRD 6.1)
nodes.rationale: Zero behavior change, passive learning first, tap for depth never forced, dark-first design, Hebrew-native UI, delight without distraction — the app serves the music, not the other way around.

nodes.label: Cost & Profitability Analysis (PRD 7.3)
nodes.rationale: Global translation cache is the most important cost lever — marginal AI cost per active user approaches ~$0 as catalog grows; break-even at ~500 premium subscribers, profitability at ~2,000.

nodes.label: Risks & Mitigations (PRD 9)
nodes.rationale: Musixmatch cost/availability at scale and Spotify free-tier Playback State API access flagged HIGH severity; mitigations include caching, fallback providers, and manual input fallback.

nodes.label: API Key Management (PRD 11.1)
nodes.rationale: All third-party API keys must be stored exclusively on the backend and never appear in the app bundle, client code, git repos, or store builds — Cloud Functions act as proxy layer.

nodes.label: Data Minimization & Privacy (PRD 11.5)
nodes.rationale: Only collect data strictly necessary; Spotify OAuth scope limited to playback state read only; raw lyrics never permanently stored, only translated line pairs, to reduce copyright liability.

nodes.label: Input Validation & Injection Prevention (PRD 11.6)
nodes.rationale: User-provided lyric lines passed as content, never injected into the system prompt, to prevent prompt injection attacks.

nodes.label: Firebase Admin Init Pattern (firebase-admin v13)
nodes.rationale: Must use getFirestore/FieldValue from firebase-admin/firestore, not admin.firestore() — FieldValue is undefined in v13 with old pattern; emulator env vars set before initializeApp.

nodes.label: .env Rules (No Quotes, LF Only)
nodes.rationale: Firebase v2 parser crashes on quoted values or CRLF line endings; must run PowerShell CRLF-strip after editing .env on Windows.

nodes.label: Authenticated Endpoint Pattern
nodes.source_location: Every authenticated endpoint must follow this pattern
nodes.rationale: verifyAppCheck -> verifyAuth -> checkRateLimit chain required on every authenticated Cloud Function endpoint.

nodes.label: Word 'Learned' Definition (CLAUDE.md)
nodes.rationale: encounterCount >= 3 AND tappedAt is set; both conditions must be true, checked after every recordWordEncounter and recordWordTap call.

nodes.label: Translation Cache (SSE two-shape)
nodes.rationale: Two SSE response shapes must both be handled by frontend: cache hit (full array at once) vs cache miss (streaming partial text events).

nodes.label: Protected Files List
nodes.source_location: What NOT to Change Without Asking / Protected files
nodes.rationale: spotifyAuth, getValidSpotifyAccessToken, verifyAuth/verifyAppCheck/checkRateLimit, firebase.js, emulator ports, and .env files must not be touched without explicit approval — high risk of breaking auth/token flows.

nodes.label: Hard Rules (Verification, Scope Discipline)
nodes.rationale: Never say done/fixed without verifying via emulator/expo run; max ~50 lines changed per bug fix; one concern per commit; pause to confirm plan if >3 files touched.

nodes.label: Session Start Checklist / Retro Process
nodes.source_location: Session Start Checklist / Session End Retro
nodes.rationale: Read latest retro in docs/retros/ at start of every session for continuity; generate a short retro (20 lines max) after every non-trivial session.

nodes.label: Token Revocation Procedures (Spotify/Musixmatch/Anthropic)
nodes.rationale: An Anthropic API key was found in git history (commit a2bc3860) and must be rotated immediately.

nodes.label: PlaybackControls Prop-Coupling Decision
nodes.rationale: PlaybackControls receives currentTrack + onPollNow as props for simplest coupling, avoiding a Zustand dependency; progress interpolates locally via lastPollRef instead of a second store subscription.

nodes.label: WordDetailModal Rendered at App Root Decision
nodes.rationale: Rendered at App root outside navigator so it overlays all 3 tabs; lyricContext injected into selectedWord object by WordCard to avoid prop drilling to modal.
nodes.norm_label: worddetailmodal rendered at app root decision

nodes.label: Bug: Wrong Lyric Context in Modal
nodes.rationale: handleWordLongPress captured activeLyricContext (always current playing line) instead of the line the word belonged to; fixed by passing the line object through renderHighlightedLine into handleWordLongPress.
nodes.norm_label: bug: wrong lyric context in modal

nodes.label: Bug: Translation Not Saved to Firestore
nodes.rationale: saveWordTranslation called updateDoc before the doc existed; fixed by removing saveWordTranslation and passing wordTranslation as a 4th arg to recordWordFlag, written at doc-creation time.
nodes.norm_label: bug: translation not saved to firestore

nodes.label: Lyric Sync Freeze — Root Cause Investigation
nodes.source_location: Lyric sync freeze — root cause + fix
nodes.rationale: Three-stage fix: (1) decouple 200ms sync interval from [lines] state to [hasLines] boolean reading from a ref; (2) remove per-token setLines calls during streaming that saturated the JS thread; (3) use a count-based gate (quote char + increased line count) to apply translations progressively without freezing sync.
nodes.norm_label: lyric sync freeze — root cause investigation

nodes.label: Retro: Cache Logic Verification and Hardening
nodes.norm_label: retro: cache logic verification and hardening

nodes.label: Global (Not Per-User) Cache Decision
nodes.rationale: All three caches are global — first user to play a song pays the LRCLIB/OpenAI cost, every subsequent user served from Firestore; 404s from LRCLIB not cached since a song may get lyrics later.

nodes.label: Retro: Lyrics Screen UX & Scroll Overhaul
nodes.norm_label: retro: lyrics screen ux & scroll overhaul

nodes.label: Bug: TouchableOpacity Blocked Scroll+Tap
nodes.rationale: Nested Text.onLongPress inside TouchableOpacity inside ScrollView caused touch responder conflict on Android; fixed by switching to Pressable + keyboardShouldPersistTaps=handled.

nodes.label: Bug: Translation Took 40s (onLayout storm)
nodes.rationale: onLayout fired on every Pressable on each streaming setLines update (50 lines x 60 chunks = 3000 callbacks); fixed via lazy measureLayout called only when auto-scroll fires.

nodes.label: measureLayout Over onLayout Decision
nodes.rationale: Lazy measurement is more accurate (reflects current heights including translations) and eliminates streaming overhead; proximity threshold 250px chosen as natural but not annoying.

nodes.label: Bug: Apostrophe-only Lines Mistranslated
nodes.rationale: LRC pause-marker lines containing only ' passed parseLRC's empty-string filter (truthy), GPT then echoed ' back as its translation; fixed by requiring at least one letter per line via regex guard.

nodes.label: Passive Learning: No Auto-Highlight Decision
nodes.rationale: Removed all auto-highlighting so no algorithm decides what the user learns; user controls what they see via a post-song focus-word picker instead.

nodes.label: flagged Field Reused for Focus Words Decision
nodes.rationale: flagged: true field reused for focus words — avoided creating a new Firestore collection; 10-level difficulty computed by dividing tier-sorted list into 10 equal buckets.
nodes.norm_label: flagged field reused for focus words decision

nodes.label: Retro: Word Quality Filter & Vocabulary Expansion
nodes.norm_label: retro: word quality filter & vocabulary expansion

nodes.label: CEFR A1-A2 Quality Gate Decision
nodes.rationale: CEFR A1-A2 chosen as the quality gate (standard linguistic framework) rather than heuristics like word length; frequencyTier LOW used as sort key for smart selection (rarest = hardest).

nodes.rationale: Rewrote theme.js to Spotify color system (bg #121212, accent #1DB954) but kept accentGreen teal #6AF7C8 for word highlights to avoid clashing with Spotify green UI accents.

nodes.label: Bug: ImageManipulator Cannot Read Remote URLs
nodes.rationale: ImageManipulator.manipulateAsync throws on remote HTTPS URLs, only accepts local file:// URIs; must download first via FileSystem; expo-file-system v55 deprecated downloadAsync requiring /legacy import path.
nodes.norm_label: bug: imagemanipulator cannot read remote urls

nodes.label: Bug: SafeAreaView Padding Unreliable in Modal on iOS
nodes.rationale: SafeAreaView doesn't reliably apply paddingHorizontal inside a Modal on iOS; fixed by moving padding to an inner View.
nodes.norm_label: bug: safeareaview padding unreliable in modal on ios

nodes.label: Bug: No Safe Area Value Available Crash
nodes.rationale: SpotifyAuth.js used useSafeAreaInsets() but the onboarding branch in App.js rendered outside SafeAreaProvider; fixed by wrapping the onboarding return with SafeAreaProvider.
nodes.norm_label: bug: no safe area value available crash

nodes.label: Bug: App Check reCAPTCHA 24h Throttle
nodes.rationale: reCAPTCHA Enterprise site key misconfigured; one 403 response triggered a 24h browser localStorage throttle blocking all subsequent attempts from that browser.

nodes.label: Bug: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS Re-injection on Deploy
nodes.rationale: Every firebase deploy --only functions re-adds a revoked key env var to Cloud Run, causing checkRateLimit to fail closed and produce 429 spam; needed manual gcloud cleanup after every deploy.

nodes.label: App Check Bypass Decision
nodes.rationale: verifyAppCheck bypassed globally (returns true) until reCAPTCHA Enterprise is properly configured; Spotify stays in dev mode (max 25 users) since quota extension requires a legal business entity.

nodes.label: Bug: App Check Throttle Blocking iOS Safari
nodes.rationale: Root cause of iOS Safari failure was the App Check 24h reCAPTCHA throttle blocking all Firestore operations; fixed by removing App Check entirely from both frontend and backend.
nodes.norm_label: bug: app check throttle blocking ios safari

nodes.label: Bug: LRCLIB CORS Blocked on iOS Safari
nodes.rationale: useLyricSync now tries direct LRCLIB fetch first, falls back to backend lyricsFetch on failure — Safari hit cache misses and LRCLIB blocked cross-origin requests with TypeError: Load failed.
nodes.norm_label: bug: lrclib cors blocked on ios safari

nodes.label: Bug: Firebase Hosting Deploying Stale Build
nodes.rationale: firebase.json had public:dist relative to backend/ but exports went to frontend/dist/; fixed by adding fs.cpSync to inject-fonts.js to sync frontend/dist to backend/dist after every build — all previous deploys that session served an old bundle.
nodes.norm_label: bug: firebase hosting deploying stale build

nodes.label: Bug: recordWordEncounter Never Called
nodes.rationale: Destructured from useWordTracking, added currentTrackRef + encounteredRef to avoid stale closures and double-counting; now fires for every psychometric word passing through the active lyric line.

nodes.label: App Check Removed Permanently Decision
nodes.rationale: Removed permanently from both frontend and backend — not needed given Spotify dev mode wall (25 users) plus verifyAuth and rate limiting.

nodes.label: Cumulative wordsLearnt AsyncStorage Decision
nodes.rationale: wordsLearnt is cumulative (not per-session reset) so a known word stays out of the filtered queue until user manually switches back to all words; stored in AsyncStorage since it's a local device preference with no backend need.
